name: Instantly
tagline: Cold email outreach platform for sending campaigns from multiple mailboxes.
best_for: Teams and agencies running cold email campaigns at volume
description:
Instantly is a cold email platform built around sending outreach campaigns from many connected mailboxes at once. You add sending accounts, upload or build a lead list, write a sequence of emails with follow-ups, and let the tool schedule sends and track replies.

Its focus is deliverability and scale: mailbox warm-up, rotating senders and a combined inbox for replies help agencies and small sales teams manage several campaigns without switching accounts. It is mainly an outreach tool, not a full CRM, so most teams pair it with a separate system for deals. Plans, limits and features change, so check the official site for current plans.
